pinnedFiles.reason: Defines ArchiveRecords, archiveTypedState, copyStageDocuments, and copyIfPresent — the exact functions the bug asks to change so the archived copy relativizes paths while the workspace copy stays byte-identical.

The only production call site of memory.ArchiveRecords (inside recordEpisode, called from run.go's defer). Whatever root/projectRoot value the fix needs must be threaded through this function's signature.

prepareRunWorkspace (builds orchestrator.StageInput.ProjectRoot as the absolute cwd) and the deferred recordEpisode(...) call at line 194 are both here — this is where the repository root the open question asks about already exists and must be passed down.
Declares StageInput.ProjectRoot with the comment establishing it as 'the repository the run targets' — the authoritative definition of the root value this fix needs to reach ArchiveRecords.

RunState.SpecPath and StageRecord.ArtifactPath/ViewPath/IterationArtifacts are the run-state.json fields that store absolute paths today and must end up relative in the archived copy. Read-only reference — this file is not edited by scope.paths.

Event.DiffPath and Event.Error are the run-events.jsonl fields that can embed the absolute repository root (e.g. a stage-failure error quoting a rejected-payload path). Read-only reference, not edited by scope.paths.

Holds every existing memory.ArchiveRecords(...) call and the fixtureRun() fixture (absolute-looking but non-root SpecPath/DiffPath values). The new root parameter changes this call's signature everywhere it's used, and these tests characterize the behavior that must not regress.
writeWorkspace(), the shared helper every archive test in ingest_test.go uses to lay down run-state.json/run-events.jsonl exactly as the executor does.

End-to-end test that builds the real loom binary and runs `loom run --provider mock` against a temp project, then asserts on the archived docs/features/user-auth/run-state.json — the natural place for a new test proving the archived file has no absolute-root substring, using buildLoomBinary/writeSpec/runLoom helpers already defined here.

pruned: docs/adrs/ADR-004-bugfix-artifacts-use-features-namespace.md — about where bugfix artifacts live (docs/features/ vs a separate namespace), not about path rewriting; this run uses plan: deliver-feature, not deliver-bugfix, so it doesn't even apply here.

docs/adrs/ADR-002-corpus-aware-retrieval-strategy.md, ADR-008, ADR-001, ADR-010 — found by a broad grep for 'archive/memory' but all concern KI retrieval, test evidence, or repo indexing, not run-record path handling.
cmd/loom/cmd/state.go — also calls prepareRunWorkspace, but it's the `loom state` inspection command and is outside scope.paths; not part of the archiving path.

docs/features/i-4-vocabulary-test/** and docs/features/context-engineering-framework/** — the only two prior deliveries with an Owning Context line (intake; Agent Orchestration). Neither matches this feature's context (Documentation Knowledge Base, per DOMAIN_DICTIONARY.md's Episodic Store/Feature Archive entries) — none found for this bounded context.

internal/state/*.go (typed stage-document schemas) — the AC calls out state/*.json in its blanket no-absolute-root assertion, but every typed document's own schema already declares repo-relative paths (e.g. context-engineer's pinnedFiles), so there is no known field there holding an absolute path to pin against.
